description: This file defines classes and behaviors for a RecycleView component in Kivy, including RecycleView, RecycleViewBehavior, and related layout and data management classes. It provides mechanisms for efficient display and interaction with large data sets in a GUI, supporting features like view recycling, viewport management, and selection.

classes.name: RecycleViewBehavior
classes.description: Provides the behavioral logic for RecycleView, including viewport management, data updates, and layout refresh mechanisms.

classes.name: RecycleView
classes.description: A flexible widget for displaying large data sets efficiently, supporting view recycling, layout management, and data binding.

methods.name: get_viewport
methods.description: Calculates and returns the current viewport coordinates and size within the RecycleView.

methods.name: save_viewport
methods.description: Saves the current viewport state (implementation not provided).

methods.name: restore_viewport
methods.description: Restores the viewport to the previously saved state (implementation not provided).

methods.name: refresh_views
methods.description: Updates the visible views based on data, layout, and viewport changes, handling layout recalculations and view visibility.

methods.name: refresh_from_data
methods.description: Triggers a refresh of views when data changes.

methods.name: refresh_from_layout
methods.description: Triggers a layout refresh when layout parameters change.

methods.name: refresh_from_viewport
methods.description: Updates views based on viewport changes without recalculating layout.
